name: video-audio
title: Audio files
description: Writes the sound of a video as an audio file: the format, the sample rate, the channels, a stretch and the track you choose, or at a loudness you set.

extract.description: Writes the sound of a video, or a stretch of it, as an audio file in the format, sample rate and channels you choose, from the audio track you choose. Use it when another step needs a particular kind of audio, such as 16 kHz mono for speech models.
extract.title: Extract the audio

media.title: Video or sound
media.description: The video or sound: an object with an absolute file path (a stored file, or a video as media.open gives it) or a path in text.

format.title: Format
format.description: The kind of file: wav (plain, the default), flac (smaller, no loss), opus or mp3 (much smaller).

sampleRate.title: Sample rate
sampleRate.description: Samples a second. Left out, the source's (48000 for normalize). Speech models read 16000.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: 1 for mono, 2 for stereo. Left out, the source's.

startMs.title: From
startMs.description: Where the stretch starts, in milliseconds (default: the start).

endMs.title: To
endMs.description: Where the stretch ends, in milliseconds (default: the end). It must be after the start.

track.title: Audio track
track.description: Which sound of a video that has more than one, counting from 0.

sampleRate.title: Sample rate
sampleRate.description: The rate asked for; null when it is the source's.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: The channels asked for; null when they are the source's.

failures.description: A param is wrong or media is missing.
FFmpeg could not be started, or could not read the audio (the file is damaged, has no such track, or has no audio).

normalize.description: Writes the sound of a video, or a stretch of it, at a loudness you set, so videos can be compared and heard at one level. It measures the sound first and then changes it by a straight gain, so the dynamics stay. A silent sound cannot be normalised.
normalize.title: Set the loudness

targetLufs.title: Loudness
targetLufs.description: The integrated loudness to reach, in LUFS (default -16: streaming and podcasts; broadcast is -23).

truePeakDb.title: Highest peak
truePeakDb.description: The highest peak allowed, in dB (default -1.5).

loudnessRange.title: Loudness range
loudnessRange.description: The loudness range allowed, in LU (default 11).

inputLufs.title: Loudness before
inputLufs.description: How loud the source was, in LUFS.

inputTruePeakDb.title: Highest peak before
inputTruePeakDb.description: The highest peak of the source, in dB.

inputLoudnessRange.title: Loudness range before
inputLoudnessRange.description: The loudness range of the source, in LU.
